_comment: APPROVED case results only. Nothing here publishes automatically — an item renders ONLY when status='published' AND approved=true. Never fabricate outcomes, settlements, verdicts, or success rates. Each result must be verifiable and is published with a 'prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome' disclaimer. Workflow: draft -> internal_review -> legal_review -> approved -> published -> archived.

_schema.practice: string (Bankruptcy | Personal Injury | Criminal Defense | Immigration)
_schema.headline: string (factual, no superlatives, no client-identifying detail without consent)
_schema.summary: string (what the matter involved and the outcome, factually stated)
_schema.status: draft | internal_review | legal_review | approved | published | archived
_schema.approved: boolean — must be true AND status='published' to render
